description: a wiry young woman with short black hair in a long black cloak of layered raven feathers falling from the shoulders behind her, a black raven-beak half mask over the upper face, a dark fitted leather jerkin, dark trousers and soft dark boots, no daggers and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in profile, facing and walking to the right, the face, chest and hips turned to the right and not towards the viewer, only one eye showing, the back and shoulders straight and upright, both hands empty and relaxed, the arms hanging naturally at the sides, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, mask or hood, hair, cloak, clothes, colours and what is on the back; the pose and the horse do not matter
the character's look in detail: face, hair, clothes and colours; the hands empty, without weapons in them
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
